name: Node.js + Express
scaffold: Crea `package.json` (type module) con express, zod, cors, dotenv; dev: typescript, tsx, vitest, supertest, @types/express, @types/node. Scripts: `dev` = `tsx watch src/server.ts`, `build` = `tsc`, `start` = `node dist/server.js`, `test` = `vitest run`. Con PostgreSQL usa `pg` y migraciones con node-pg-migrate.
